description: CsNa₃Li₁₂(GeO₄)₄ crystallizes in the tetragonal I4/m space group. Cs is bonded in a body-centered cubic geometry to eight equivalent O atoms. All Cs-O bond lengths are 3.01 Å. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted body-centered cubic geometry to eight O atoms. There are four shorter (2.57 Å) and four longer (2.84 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a body-centered cubic geometry to eight equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.83 Å. There are two inequivalent Li sites. In the first Li site, Li is bonded to four O atoms to form LiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent GeO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four equivalent LiO₄ trigonal pyramids, and edges with two equivalent LiO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.08 Å. In the second Li site, Li is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted LiO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent LiO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent GeO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four equivalent LiO₄ trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one LiO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one GeO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 1.94-2.20 Å. Ge is bonded to four O atoms to form GeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent LiO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four equivalent LiO₄ trigonal pyramids, and edges with two equivalent LiO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Ge-O bond distances ranging from 1.77-1.80 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, three Li, and one Ge atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂Li₃Ge octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 66°. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, three Li, and one Ge atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Cs, one Na, three Li, and one Ge atom.
